title: SREV-009 session-0 CreateProcessAsUser token shape

createprocessasuser_shape.description: CreateProcessAsUserW requires a primary token with TOKEN_QUERY, TOKEN_DUPLICATE, TOKEN_ASSIGN_PRIMARY; the new process runs in the session specified in the token

duplicate_token_shape.description: DuplicateToken creates an impersonation token that cannot be used with CreateProcessAsUser; DuplicateTokenEx(TokenPrimary) creates a primary token

session0_topology.description: Session-0 path opens SbieSvc's process token into a separate Session0PrimaryTokenHandle owner with TOKEN_ASSIGN_PRIMARY|TOKEN_DUPLICATE|TOKEN_IMPERSONATE|TOKEN_QUERY|STANDARD_RIGHTS_READ, points PrimaryTokenHandle at it, then duplicates a separate ImpersonationTokenHandle for thread impersonation

lifetime_invariant.description: The selected PrimaryTokenHandle stays alive until after CreateProcessAsUser; only the local Session0PrimaryTokenHandle is closed before function return

failure_topology.description: OpenProcessToken failure is fail-closed and preserves GetLastError

runtime_matrix.description: Windows session-0 launch smoke proves the child process token/session matches the intended SbieSvc SYSTEM token path

contracts: CreateProcessAsUserW requires a primary token; impersonation tokens are not accepted
Session-0 path must not close/nul the selected primary token before CreateProcessAsUser
Local Session0PrimaryTokenHandle owns the temporary SbieSvc primary token
DuplicateToken(SecurityImpersonation) produces a separate ImpersonationTokenHandle for SetThreadToken
OpenProcessToken failure preserves GetLastError and fails closed
